packageRules.description: Flux controller images must move with their CRDs, so only the flux manager may touch the generated system manifest
Renovate has bumped only the version header of the system manifest before, so every Flux PR carries the regenerate command
prBodyNotes: Before merging, confirm the controller images and CRDs changed, not only the version header. If they did not, regenerate the manifest with `flux install --export --version={{{newVersion}}} > GitOps/clusters/reference/flux-system/gotk-components.yaml` and push it to this branch.
